summary: Two critical figure crop defects: p2-fig1 is clipped on the right edge (missing ellipse completion and point B label), and p2-sol-fig2 contains only page text instead of the required diagram.

defects.description: Crop bbox [160, 345, 500, 460] clips the ellipse on the right edge, cutting off the right half of the ellipse continuation and the point B label at the bottom. The printed figure shows a complete ellipse with points A (top) and B (bottom), semi-major axis a, semi-minor axis b, and vertical orientation marker. The crop ends before reaching these elements.

Figure ID p2-sol-fig2 crop at bbox [220, 760, 790, 965] on solutions page 5 contains only page heading text ('III крьг на IV национална олимпиада по астрономия, април 2001г.' and Problem 3 statement) instead of the ellipse diagram that should appear on this page. The actual figure with points A and B, semi-major axis a, semi-minor axis b, the Sun position marking, and rotation direction arrow is not shown. The crop boundaries are incorrect.
